verdict.summary: Anthropic's official webapp-testing skill. Teaches Claude to write Python Playwright scripts that open local web apps in a headless Chromium, click around, take screenshots and read console logs. One helper script (with_server.py) starts a dev server command you give it, waits for the port, runs your test, then stops the server. Example scripts only touch localhost and write screenshots/logs. No network calls to third parties, no credential access. Needs the playwright Python package (1.65.2) plus its Chromium download.
